reviews.reviewText: Kafi MCQs mutation ke mutaliq thay. Bohat zyada conceptual questions thay like 'agar ye function kharab ho jaye to kya hoga'. Mendel's law ke 2-3 questions thay. Paper 50% conceptual tha.

MCQs: Mitosis, Meiosis, Mendel's law, Mitochondria, Viruses, Bacteria, Organelles, Ecology.
Zyada tar Mitosis Meiosis or unke phases se related thay.
Topics: Heart, Lungs, Small Intestine.

Paper was 50/50 Handouts and Concepts.
Topics:
- Mitosis & Meiosis (5-6 MCQs).
- Scenarios ('What if', 'Cause and effect').
- PCR (2-3 MCQs).
- Ecosystem (Carnivore, Omnivore, Producer, Desert habitat).
- Phylum types.
- Anatomy: Heart, Colon, Lungs placement, Nephron, Cytoplasm.
- Microscope oil usage.
- Immunity (Innate & Adaptive).
- Bacteriophages.
- Blotting.
Paper easy tha. Mid se kam aur final lessons se zyada questions aaye. 2-3 MCQs insight quiz videos se thay, baqi zyada tar handouts se aaye.
